decision: One invocation performs one resumable bounded cycle
why: Two supervised cycles were selected; avoid introducing a daemon or unbounded model spend

decision: Use immutable capture/decision files and per-cycle commit markers instead of mutable JSONL state
why: A crash must preserve evidence without partially advancing the signal ledger

decision: Refresh every bounded tracked case and keep a fixed initial discovery start for a 24-hour pilot
why: Creation-only polling would miss updates and late labels; exact coverage and caps stay visible

decision: Freeze detector source fingerprint and collection scope in the store
why: A changed rule must not silently rewrite comparisons within an observation experiment

decision: Bound one store to 24 default and 48 maximum cycles
why: Bound disk and repeated model spend within the 24-hour pilot

decision: Persist preparation time separately from commit time
why: Recovered decisions must not appear durably emitted before recovery
result: Commit is the visible ledger advancement

decision: Use native authenticated fx for independent reviews
why: Existing agents returned acknowledgements without files; fresh delegation hit thread limit
result: Root implementation with different-family reviews through fx

decision: Preserve action errors while attempting lock removal after close failure
why: Independent review found close errors masked the action and skipped unlink
evidence: hardening-fx.json; regression red on action failed vs close failed; restored green

decision: Checksum each persisted payload, including pending captures
why: A not-yet-committed capture otherwise has no retained checksum to compare on resume

decision: Freeze fx cwd and optional requested model in scope
why: Avoid switching project MCP context or transport model silently; user requests avoiding unsupported web-search routing
